title: ContextMessage
description: Provider-agnostic buffer entry — CTX-01. No domain noun is a first-class field.

role.description: Message role. Frozen enum; adding a role is a MINOR (optional handling), renaming is MAJOR.

content.description: Message text. Empty string is valid (CTX-RES-01 empty handling). Large content allowed — CTX-AC-03 handles oversize.

metadata.description: CTX-04 operates ONLY on metadata + counts, never on content semantics.

timestamp.description: Creation time ISO-8601. Optional; used for ordering diagnostics, not truncation priority.

pinned.description: If true, truncation strategies must never evict this entry (CTX-04 pinned handling). Typically system prompt is pinned.

priority.description: Higher priority retained preferentially when strategy supports priority (future strategies). Default 0. Strategies that ignore priority document so.

id.description: Optional stable id (kebab-case). Not used by truncation; for caller correlation.

token_count.description: Cached token count for this entry under the active model_profile. Optional; if absent, counter computes it. Cache is invalidated when model_profile changes.
